topic: Removing old impression blocks from stage
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on the removal of an outdated block used for impressions on the staging environment. It was determined that this old impression block should be removed globally, provided there is a dedicated panel for impressions.

[p1] noted that the need to remove it was highlighted during a recent demo by someone else (Sasha).

It was agreed that [me] would implement the removal for users who have new impressions.
decisions: The old impression block on staging should be removed globally if an impression panel exists.
[me] implemented the removal for users with new impressions.
action_items: Need to coordinate with Esben to confirm global removal of the impression block.
